note: Append-only event log of the ENA type test register (Type = Plug-in Solar).

events.note: First reading of the plug-in solar filter. Four devices were listed. Individual references were not recorded at the time, so none are itemised for this reading.

The register’s own on-page filter returned three plug-in solar devices while its search API returned four — the filter was under-reporting. Recorded here as the filter showed it, with that caveat. References were not fully recorded.
Four devices, all listed non-compliant. Individual references were not recorded at the time, so none are itemised for this reading.

Eleven plug-in solar devices. Four were listed compliant, all from UKSOL — the first plug-in solar entries on the register to carry that status. Two GoodWe entries that were present on 11 August had gone. INSTA/20951 was superseded from V1/A1 to V1/A2. Full references below.
